messages:
marta: :rotating_light: incident-bot reported escalation queue growth, but pagerflow isn't sending pages. seeing ~120 queued events at /alerts/queue. some customers reporting delayed support responses.
eli: are pages being sent to PD at all? or just our internal slack automation failing?
marta: looks like PD API returns 200 for create_event, but pagerflow logs show 5xx on the webhook relay. stack traces below.
incident-bot: Automated alert: escalation-queue length=122, oldest_event_age=00:32:18, fallback_attempts=0.
kim: paging loop risk. last deploy to pagerflow was 03:14 UTC today? can someone check deploy bot logs?
darren: I didn't touch pagerflow. checking deploys now. `kubectl -n infra get pods | grep pagerflow` -> one crashloopbackoff on relay-connector-2.
eli: crashloop looks like TLS handshake errors to pagerduty-ingress. maybe cert rotated?
marta: confirm: yesterday we rotated vault certs for pagerflow sevice. maybe the connector didn't pick up new CA.
support-ops: we started getting customer pings about escalations delayed around 03:20 UTC. ticket count up ~15 in last 30m.
kim: immediate plan: (1) disable automatic suppression so incidents still post to slack, (2) manually page oncall for high-sev, (3) attempt restart of relay-connector after env reload.
darren: restarting relay-connector-2 now `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/pagerflow-relay`
eli: while restart happens, can someone run a manual curl to the pagerflow webhook to reproduce? `curl -v -X POST https://pagerflow.internal/api/v1/relay -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @test-payload.json`
marta: sending test now... response: `502 Bad Gateway` with `upstream read timeout`.
kim: that points at upstream pagerduty-ingress being unhealthy. check connectivity from relay pods `curl -v https://pagerduty-host/api/v1/events`
darren: from pod: `curl: (60) SSL: certificate problem: certificate has expired` -> yep cert expired.
eli: who rotated certs? this looks like we failed to apply updated cert bundle on pagerduty-host.
marta: Ops runbook step: escalate to infra-secrets and rotate the cert, but as interim we need manual pages for sev>2. I'm going to paste instructions for manual handoff.
incident-bot: NOTE: automatic oncall handoff suppressed due to webhook failure. Please follow manual handoff in #oncall if needed.
support-ops: I'll start paging manually for the affected customers and add annotations to tickets: "Paging delayed due to internal paging relay outage".
kim: paging list: @darren oncall -> call flow -> escalate to SRE manager if unresponsive after 10 min. darren are you oncall?
darren: I'm the oncall primary. I acknowledged the manual pages. pinging phone now.
marta: mitigation: (a) add temporary fallback that posts a DM to oncall Slack when relay errors exceed 5 in 1m (b) start rolling update to attach new CA to relay pods.
eli: I can push the fallback change as a config flip: `relay.error_fallback=slack_dm` — can someone approve?
kim: approved. go ahead.
eli: flipped config and redeployed small patch. see logs: `fallback to slack_dm executed for event id 0x7f9a`. messages coming through as DMs to oncall.
incident-bot: Fallback engaged: sending DMs to oncall. queued alerts drained from 122 -> 18 after fallback.
support-ops: thanks — started clearing urgent tickets. customers on SLA impacted list: acct-224, acct-331, acct-998. adding postmortem tags.
darren: Received DM and called into the top 3. this mitigates immediate customer impact. we should still fix the cert properly.
marta: infra update: created PR to refresh CA bundle for pagerduty-host and added an integration test that validates TLS handshake during deploy. PR #482.
eli: test-run: after CA bundle update, relay pod TLS checks pass locally. planning to rotate certs and restart pagerduty-host at 04:10 UTC.
kim: coordinate with oncall before rotating — we could create transient noise. darren, available for brief window?
darren: available now. do it.
marta: rotation in progress. I'll watch queued length.
incident-bot: hook: pagerflow relay connection re-established at 04:15 UTC, queued alerts forwarded.
eli: queued drain finished. count -> 0. PD events show acknowledges created for manual pages.
support-ops: customer tickets updated. SLA breaches avoided for 2 of 3, one had >30m delay — support reached out with apology and credit offer.
kim: post-incident actions (short): 1) add CA rotation alert to infra dashboards, 2) add automatic fallback to DM on sustained 5xx from relay, 3) runbook update for manual paging + handoff, 4) add healthcheck that fails deploy if TLS handshake fails.
marta: agreed. I'll file the postmortem doc and assign owners.
darren: quick note — communication: next time include a short template message for support to send to customers (saves time). I'll draft one.
eli: tagging infra-secrets for root cause review.
kim: thanks everyone. closing thread when postmortem link is up. :thumbsup:
marta: postmortem link: https://redwood.company/postmortems/195021 - draft created, owners assigned. closing thread in 30m."
